observation_boundary: The commit that first adds this observations-scoped-6713.json file.

observation_run.context: Scoped rerun of the ten #6128 baseline queries after PR #6737 added a caller-supplied scope argument to search_knowledge. Measures scope only; usefulness and evidence coverage were not re-judged.
observation_run.scope_filter_mechanism: The scope argument on the MCP search_knowledge tool.
observation_run.deployed_configuration_or_revision_reaso: The tool response did not expose deployment configuration or revision.
observation_run.latency_measurement: Timestamps from date -u in a Bash tool call immediately before and after each MCP call from a cloud session. They include model turn overhead and tool orchestration, so they are approximate client wall time and not server processing latency.

redaction.policy: Preserve full candidate evidence only for the requested public repository scope. Withhold title and note_id for any off-scope or personal candidate while preserving rank, score, and scope class.

queries_returning_fewer_than_20.note: Under the scope filter the result budget is not always filled, so the denominator is the number of returned candidates, not 20 times the query count.

unavailable_measurements: Deployed knowledge service configuration and revision.
